- Latency target: p95 < 120ms for topk=20 in Hosted; Dedicated required if throughput > 200 req/s.
- Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to commit if unit economics improve 30% vs current managed infra.

- They want eval harness: sample query set (~20k), ground-truth clicks, nDCG/precision tracking.
- Mentioned competitors: prototyping with Elastic rerank plugin but worried about scale and cost.

use_case_summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product discovery) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for a targeted rerank POC; intention to move to Dedicated if performance/latency and unit-cost targets met. Focused on reproducible offline scoring, per-request feature logging, and model fallbacks.

internal_notes: AE to push pricing scenarios for 12-month commit if Dedicated chosen. Ask finance for mid-market slider. Consider offering extended eval support (SE hours) as concession. Monitor INF-5421 for infra questions.
